title: Design: release-day matrix page shows only the Default column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a staging client on which nobody has set up tiers since the release.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click a category matrix's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices tab lists the matrices that existed before the release, the General Matrix first with its Default badge.
  • Each row shows the matrix name, a status badge, its categories, a Work Order Matrix summary, Part Sale Matrix "Same as work orders" and Tiers "All", as in picture 1.2.

Step 2:

  • The grid shows Cost Range and one Default column headed "1 Default".
  • Under the grid the Price Part Simulator shows a Part Cost box and one Default price with its profit, as in picture 1.4.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
